europe_now.title: Wildfires spread across France and Greece
europe_now.summary: Major wildfires are causing evacuations in Athens suburb and other regions, with firefighters containing some fires but others remaining uncontrolled. The incidents highlight Europe's vulnerability to climate-driven disasters.

europe_now.title: Ceuta migration crisis intensifies
europe_now.summary: Over 60,000 migrants crossed into Ceuta from Morocco in 2026, with 57 deaths reported. Spain and EU partners are in conflict over migration policy responses, raising systemic security concerns.

top_stories.title: European Wildfire Crisis
top_stories.summary: Wildfires in France and Greece have prompted mass evacuations and strained firefighting resources. Containment efforts are partial, with uncontrolled blazes continuing to spread.

top_stories.title: Ceuta Migration Surge
top_stories.summary: Ceuta experienced a record migrant influx in 2026, with 60,000 crossings and 57 fatalities. The crisis has triggered diplomatic tensions between Spain and EU partners over border management.
